forum.title: STM32N657L0H3Q unused USB power pins?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@foc

I got the confirmation. It’s better to connect VDD33USB and VDDA18USB to GND to minimize any possible leakage.
forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I want to design STM32N6 based board and in this board I don’t have any 3.3V supply so what should I do the unused USB power pins? Should I left unconnected or connect them to GND?

Thanks and regards
forum.author: foc
